Weather System: Tropical Depression CRISING
Issued at: 8:00 PM, 17 July 2025(Thursday)

Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Batangas, Cavite, Laguna, Bataan, Pampanga, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal and Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Atimonan, Padre Burgos, Plaridel, Unisan) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

LOOK: Here is the breakdown of votes per candidate in the 46th UPM University Student Council (USC) General Elections, following the canvassing of ballots by the University Electoral Board.

In the contested chairperson race, Nuraini Nordin emerged as the winner with 47.37% of the votes, surpassing opponent Abraham Gaddi who received 35.10%.

Councilor candidates Jyca Santos and Sai Simbulan obtained 72.83% and 69.72% of the votes, respectively.

A total of 2,926 students out of 6,110 cast their votes. This amounts to a 47.95% turnout, a significant increase from last year’s 37.70%. 

Students with objections or complaints regarding the election process may file them through this link: https://t.co/ZZpSoXAANU.

The post-election protest period ends tomorrow, July 18.

#BotoUPM2025
